messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they give sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and population mean 98.6. They want to compute the p-value? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" maybe means "standard deviation for the null hypothesis test"? But they already gave sample std dev. Maybe they want to compute the standard error? Or compute the t-statistic? The question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" Might be asking to compute the standard error of the mean under null? Actually standard error = sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). That equals 1.4 / 6.3249 = 0.2215. Then t-statistic = (sample_mean - population_mean) / SE = (98.2 - 98.6)/0.2215 = -0.4/0.2215 = -1.805. Then p-value two-tailed? Use t distribution df=39. p-value ~ 0.078? Let's approximate: t=1.805, df=39. Using t table: For df=40, t=1.684 gives p=0.10, t=2.021 gives p=0.05. So 1.805 gives p between 0.10 and 0.05, maybe ~0.08. So p-value ~0.08. So answer: standard error ~0.2215, t-statistic ~-1.805, p-value ~0.08. Provide explanation.
